sections.title: Overview
sections.content: FIXR is a leading ticketing platform in the UK, providing comprehensive solutions for event organizers and attendees. The platform spans web, iOS, and Android applications, serving millions of users annually.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.content: As Senior UX/UI Designer, I led the design of FIXR's ticketing platforms across web and mobile applications. Key responsibilities included creating intuitive user flows, developing a cohesive design system, and ensuring a seamless cross-platform experience.

sections.title: Key Achievements
sections.content:
• Redesigned the ticket purchasing flow, reducing abandonment rate by 25%
• Developed a comprehensive design system used across all platforms
• Implemented rapid prototyping methodology for faster iteration cycles
• Led the UX research initiative to improve platform usability

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Building Management Platform was a comprehensive solution combining hotel management, customer relationship management, and financial operations into a single, cohesive system.

sections.title: Project Evolution
sections.content: Starting in 2017, I took on the challenge of transforming an incomplete backend system into a fully-functional management platform. The project underwent multiple iterations, evolving from an internal tool to a viable SaaS solution.

sections.title: Key Features
sections.content:
• Integrated booking management system
• Advanced financial tracking and reporting
• Comprehensive analytics dashboard
• Customer relationship management tools
• Staff training and onboarding modules

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Community App was designed to enhance resident experience in community-focused apartment buildings, facilitating communication and engagement between residents and staff.

sections.title: Development Process
sections.content: The app was developed through extensive user research and iterative design. Starting with an MVP focused on core features, we continuously expanded functionality based on user feedback and business requirements.

sections.title: Feature Set
sections.content:
• Streamlined onboarding experience
• Interest-based community groups
• Direct messaging system
• Events platform
• Help and support system
• Content management system for staff

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Marketing Website project involved creating a modern, high-performance website to showcase the company's unique offering and drive sales conversions.

sections.title: Design Approach
sections.content: The website was designed with a focus on user experience, ensuring potential customers could easily understand the company's value proposition and navigate to relevant information. Special attention was paid to the sales funnel optimization.

sections.title: Components
sections.content:
• Main marketing website
• Room booking platform
• Events section
• Workspace offerings
• Multiple targeted microsites
• Sales conversion funnels

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Kuula TV is a media platform focused on delivering high-quality video content to viewers while providing content creators with robust management tools.

sections.title: Design Scope
sections.content: The project encompassed branding, website design, and the development of a comprehensive media management system. A key focus was creating an intuitive interface for content uploading and organization.

sections.title: Key Features
sections.content:
• Intuitive content organization system
• Mobile-optimized upload interface
• Basic video editing capabilities
• Course and collection management
• Multi-format content support (video, PDF, audio)
• Partner microsites

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Breezie was an innovative Android-based operating system designed specifically for elderly and disabled users, focusing on accessibility and ease of use.

sections.title: Research & Development
sections.content: The project involved extensive user research with elderly users, leading to a complete UX/UI overhaul. The design incorporated scalable functionality that could grow with users' comfort levels.

sections.title: Components
sections.content:
• Customizable Android OS
• Family management portal
• SmartThings dashboard for care homes
• Device management system
• Training materials and documentation
• Packaging and print materials
